heardByWhisper: One continuous examination of Yerash's desk and papers, clearly enumerating each discovered  document. This is the desk of Yerash. On it is a litter of papers. Among the papers on  the desk you find the following and slip them into your journal. A letter from the boss,  telling Yerash to join or die. Entry 33. An unsent reply to this letter.  Entry 49. A message to the buccaneers offering a bounty for a real Sohuagan.  Entry 27. A warning to an agent about the dangers in the mountains to the northwest.  Entry 56. A note to a trapper about kobolds and hobgoblins. Entry 40.
